name: Chitose Kotarou
source:
2nd year high school student, the protagonist's childhood friend.
A sports fool who has confidence in his body.
A kind guy who loves the protagonist, but he patiently keeps it to himself.
He's not good at studying, but he is a part of the library committee along with the protagonist.
